model_policy.api_key_source: macOS Keychain service istara-pi-deepseek / account openclaw

sampling_rules: No-cost deterministic inventory covers all discovered scenario metadata.
At most three live core eval cases are selected for the first batch.
Skill-heavy and model-heavy categories are sampled by representative static/live cases only.
Production services, credentials, migrations, real channels, or missing Pi adapters are blocked/deferred and remain in denominator.
Owner clarification: representative feasible slices should cover every category where safe, with oversized fanout capped at three representatives per category/skill group.

cf_control_plane.limitation: CF status reported registered=false and staleness unknown/no snapshot; graph retrieval had no durable index source, so source inspection and inventory parsing were used as fallback evidence.

clarification_extension.owner_clarification: Inventory all Istara harness categories, run representative feasible slices, cap oversized fanout at max 3, keep hard total spend cap USD 0.50.
clarification_extension.replacement_scoring_delta: none; additions are baseline/static or plan-only harness evidence, not Pi replacement adapter runs
blockers_preserved: Full real-user probe/full modes require live app services, donated compute/live chat, or sandbox orchestration.
Full simulation scenarios require browser/API services and may mutate test app state; only static module validation was run for missing broad category coverage.
Security/external-service scenarios remain deferred unless explicitly authorized with proper sandbox/credentials.
